name: Review
description: Single customer review card in the #reviews marquee rail. The rail's aggregate numbers (4.8 / 8,000+ / 12 lakh+) are section settings, not metaobjects - they have no native platform source.

field_definitions.name: Product
field_definitions.description: Product the review refers to; shown on the card. Optional.

field_definitions.name: Headline
field_definitions.description: Short headline, e.g. "Sparkling taps, no elbow grease".

field_definitions.name: Verified
field_definitions.description: Shows the verified-purchase check on the card.
